text:
maria-plat: Heads-up — planning a client-side opt-in header for Feature X. header name: `X-RW-Feature-Opt-In`.
Link to PR: https://git.redwood/infra/feature-x-optin (WIP)
Can we confirm the canary audience plan and backward-compat behavior?

ajay: +1. Proposed rule: only honor header when client version >= 2.4.0. Older SDKs ignore header and keep current behavior. Server defaults to OFF unless header present and version check passes. Sound good?

taylor: Sounds safe. Server should also validate the model capability before enabling (i.e., fallback if not supported). We'll log mismatches.

sophie: For observability, I'll add metrics: `feature_x.header_opt_in` and `feature_x.opt_in_mismatch` and a grafana panel. Also track p50/p95 latency for opt-in vs baseline. :chart_with_upwards_trend:

maria-plat: Canary cadence thinking: 1% first 24h, 5% next 48h, 20% next 72h, then full. Who will flip the percentages? @ajay?

ajay: I can operate flips. Plan: manual increase with automated rollback if error rate delta > 5% or latency regression > 15%. Will document thresholds and alerts.

taylor: Add SDK smoke tests: calling `client.enableFeatureX()` sends the header; older SDKs (2.3.x) must not send it. Also e2e in staging to exercise header parsing. I'll queue a review for the PR later today.

sophie: QA checklist: 1) Curl with `X-RW-Feature-Opt-In: true` against staging, 2) Test with SDK 2.3.9 to confirm no header present, 3) Confirm mismatch metric increments if header present but model unsupported.

maria-plat: Docs need a short note in DevEx and a changelog entry for the SDK. @emily-docs can you add examples and snippet?

emily-docs: Yep — I'll add an example using `client.enableFeatureX()` and note server-side guardrails. Will also add quick upgrade guidance for customers. ETA: today EOD.

deploy-bot: deploy started: infra/feature-x-server canary -> 2 instances (build 2026.04.12-rc3) :rocket:

ajay: Small implementation detail: header parsing should be case-insensitive and accept `true|1|yes`. Canonical example: `X-RW-Feature-Opt-In: true` or `X-RW-Feature-Opt-In: 1`.

taylor: Server parsing already accepts `1|true|yes` and normalizes. We'll also verify char encoding and whitespace.

maria-plat: Rollout schedule: merge PR at 14:00 UTC, deploy canary at 15:00 UTC, flip 1% at 16:00 UTC, monitor 24h. If green, manual increases per cadence.

ajay: Ping me 10m prior to the 16:00 flip. I'll be on standby.

sophie: I'll add alert runbook for the opt-in metric and create the grafana dashboard link in the PR.

emily-docs: I'll drop a quickstart snippet in the PR description so SDK releases can link to it.

taylor: Quick code-review note: tests in CI must include header serialization test and backwards-compat test matrix for 2.3.x/2.4.x.

maria-plat: Thanks all — if no objections I'll merge after taylor's review. Will post final flip timestamp here before doing it. :thumbsup:
